title: feat(widgets): add getWidgetRenderState and getRenderState
body:
**Summary**

this new hook allows us to read the render state from every connector to be able to refine from outside of a widget and from the arguments in panel for a wrapped widget

**Result**

* all widgets have getWidgetRenderState, getRenderState
* you can access `renderState` from the InstantSearch instance
* you can access the render state from hidden, collapsed and templates in the panel widget
